artist.title: The Artist
artist.subtitle: Discover the journey and passion of Marjolène Lasne, a French painter inspired by Mediterranean light and the beauty of the south of France.

0.quote: Colour reigns supreme, harmonies contrast and the execution is exquisite! Marjolène Lasne has the gift of heightening the musicality of tones, of illuminating landscapes and figures with her lively, vibrant brushwork. Beautifully staged, her compositions evoke fleeting moments full of charm and serenity. Vivid and joyful, her palette is unique!
0.author: Gwénaëlle de Carné

1.quote: Inspired by daily life captured with sketchbook in hand, this artist brings scenes to life with a joyful palette. This colourful and harmonious alchemy relies on contrasts of colour and texture to punctuate the composition. The lively brushwork reveals the attitudes of figures, at the market or the café, at the concert or the beach. Respectful of atmospheres, Marjolène Lasne plays with volumes and architecture to give her work a panoramic character, with a spatial quality for the orchestras whose silhouettes stand against a timeless background.
1.author: Thierry Sznytka
1.source: In ARTS ACTUALITÉS MAGAZINE – Special Edition January 2006
